details.about: Mastercard is looking for a Software Engineer II to design, build and improve production-grade AI platform capabilities behind AI-powered products and agentic experiences across B&MI. The role builds reusable platform services, orchestration and runtime capabilities, and integration patterns that let models, agents, tools, enterprise data and services run safely and observably in customer-facing products, alongside senior engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and product managers.
duties: Design, develop, test and maintain AI platform services and reusable capabilities
Implement secure integration patterns for models, agents, tools, data and services, with attention to authorization, auditability and observability
Contribute to orchestration and runtime: routing, stateful workflows and asynchronous multi-step execution
Build reusable components for model and tool invocation, context management, error handling, retries and timeouts
Apply patterns for identity, permissions, policy enforcement, evaluation and guardrails
Write unit, functional and integration tests
Support operations through logging, monitoring, tracing and incident investigation
Take part in code reviews and design discussions
needs: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Professional experience building and supporting production-grade software, services or platforms
Object-oriented backend development in Java, Kotlin, Python or similar
Solid foundation in software design, data structures and the SDLC
Experience developing APIs, services, integrations or asynchronous workflows
Working knowledge of authentication, authorization, service-to-service security and API security
Understanding of secure coding, reliability, observability, automated testing and production support
nice: Integrating LLMs, ML models or AI services into applications
Agent frameworks, workflow engines, orchestration platforms, retrieval patterns or AI evaluation tools
Audit-friendly, policy-driven platforms, guardrails or responsible AI practices
details.benefits: Base salary $92,000 – $147,000 a year in Atlanta, Georgia; may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. Benefits generally include medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; flexible spending and health savings accounts; 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave; 80 hours of paid sick and safe time, 25 days of vacation and 5 personal days (pro-rated by hire date); 10 paid U.S. holidays; a 401k with company match; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; and tuition reimbursement eligibility.
notes: Mastercard intends to fill this position by 02/02/2027
Accommodations for the application process: reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com
